Name: SWORD_ARTS_PARAM_ST
Description:
Defines Ashes of War, including unique AoW. Determines AoW animation.
Behaviour data remains in BehaviourParam. Unique AoW data is with the weapon and not with other AoW data.

Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (ER's Disable Param slot). Retail 1 on 185 rows, 0 on 9.

Fields.Name: Sort Group ID
Fields.Description: Sort group: skills with the same group are listed together when sorting by item type. 255: none. Retail: 200 on 90 hero-specific skills; 10–140 on the others.

Fields.Name: Skill Speed Type
Fields.Description: Retail: 2 on 147 skills, 1 on 43 (including No Skill), 0 on 4. No reader was found in the game code.
Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Use Right-hand Skill in Left Hand
Fields.Description: When the weapon with this skill is in the left hand and neither weapon is two-handed, the right-hand weapon's skill is used instead (for animations and the skill shown in the HUD).

Fields.Name: Grey Out in Left Hand
Fields.Description: The HUD shows the skill as unusable while the weapon is in the left hand (ignored when Use Right-hand Skill in Left Hand is set). Retail: set on 172 of 194 skills.

Fields.Name: Grey Out in Right Hand
Fields.Description: The HUD shows the skill as unusable while the weapon is held one-handed in the right hand. Retail: set only on Torch Attack.

Fields.Name: Grey Out When Two-Handed
Fields.Description: The HUD shows the skill as unusable while the weapon is two-handed. Retail: set only on Torch Attack.

Fields.Name: Enable Sparring Grounds/Visual Codex
Fields.Description: Allows skill to appear in Sparring Grounds/Visual Codex

Fields.Name: Allowed on Straight Swords
Fields.Description: Set: a skill change from a special effect (such as a relic's) may give this skill to a Straight Sword. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Skill Type
Fields.Description: Skill type handed to the character's behaviour script, which picks the skill's animations. Retail: a different value for nearly every skill (0–260).

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: Sort order of the skill when sorted by order. Retail: one value per skill (0–30000). No reader was found in the game code.

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: Text ID for arts description

Fields.Name: FP Cost: L1
Fields.Description: FP cost of the skill when used with L1. The cost is multiplied by the active SpEffects' Skill FP Consumption % and rounded up.

Fields.Name: FP Cost: L2
Fields.Description: FP cost of the skill's main use (L2). The cost is multiplied by the active SpEffects' Skill FP Consumption % and rounded up. The skill counts as short of FP when current FP is 0 or below half the cost. The HUD and menus show this cost (the HUD marks the skill when FP is below half of it); when it is 0 or less they show the lower positive one of R1/R2.

Fields.Name: FP Cost: R1
Fields.Description: FP cost of a skill use or follow-up on R1 (for example bow skills, stance follow-ups). Scaled and checked like FP Cost: L2.

Fields.Name: FP Cost: R2
Fields.Description: FP cost of a skill use or follow-up on R2. Scaled and checked like FP Cost: L2.

Fields.Name: Default Weapon Affinity
Fields.Description: Affinity given to the weapon when this skill is rolled onto it (custom weapons) or applied to it: the weapon ID becomes that affinity's variant. 0: standard. Retail: Sacred, Magic, Blood, Flame Art, Cold, Lightning or Poison on 39 elemental skills.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Skill icon shown in the HUD.

Fields.Name: AI Usage ID
Fields.Description: Value returned to AI scripts by GetAIUsageParam for this skill; the scripts use it to decide when to use the skill. Its meaning is script-defined. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Usability Text ID
Fields.Description: Menu text ID for the skill's usability line. −1: none. Retail: 63099 on 91 hero-specific skills. No reader was found in the game code.

Fields.Name: Menu Attack ID
Fields.Description: AtkParam_Pc row the item status menu uses to calculate the skill's attack power property. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Sparring Grounds Weapon
Fields.Description: Weapon given with this skill on it when the skill is picked in the Sparring Grounds. −1: none. Retail: a weapon of a type the skill fits (Longsword 2000000 for Square Off).

Fields.Name: Appearance Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that must be on for the skill to be listed in the Sparring Grounds and the Visual Codex (with Enable Sparring Grounds/Visual Codex). 0 or −1: always listed. Retail: 6301 on Storm Ruler.
